title: Stranger with Air Force ties at Hart Canyon

tellings.quote: A stranger with curious ties to the Air Force. He showed up at Hart Canyon, which is very obscure and hard to get to at the same time we did.

plain: In 2026, a stranger with curious ties to the US Air Force turned up at Hart Canyon, near Aztec, New Mexico, a remote, hard-to-reach spot, at the very moment Michels and his crew arrived. Michels tells this himself, as something that happened to him while looking into a reported crash there said to have left sixteen alien bodies, and the timing struck him as more than chance.
